daily_dinacharya_routine.recommended_routine: Brahma Muhurta awakening (approx 05:30 AM), gentle warm water rinse, tongue scraping, and 15-minute mindfulness/Pranayama. Warm sesame oil self-massage (Abhyanga) followed by a warm bath.
Main meal of the day (highest digestive period). Sit quietly for 10 minutes post-meal. Avoid immediate strenuous work.
Unwind period: 15–20 minutes of gentle walking or calming Pranayama (Anulom Vilom). Light, warm dinner before 07:30 PM.
Digital detox 1 hour before sleep. Warm foot massage (Padabhyanga) with ghee/sesame oil. In-bed by 10:00 PM.

seasonal_ritucharya_plan.dietary_guidelines: Favor bitter, pungent, and astringent tastes. Avoid heavy, oily, sweet foods and daytime sleep.
seasonal_ritucharya_plan.lifestyle_guidelines: Engage in active physical exercise, dry massage, and warm herbal tea consumption.
seasonal_ritucharya_plan.individualized_note: Plan tailored for primary constitution: Vata.

disclaimer: This daily and seasonal regimen is supportive lifestyle advice based on AYUSH principles. It does not substitute clinical treatment directives.
